_help: Racing series shown as playlists in the Racing menu (cycle them with the wheel's button 3 / P, back with button 2 / O). Each series: the words its games' titles contain (case-insensitive regular expressions). A game can be in more than one series; only series with at least 2 games on the cabinet get a playlist. Every version of a game is kept - playlists only group them. Order here = order when cycling. Edit freely, then run tools\New-SeriesPlaylists.ps1 (Rebuild Game Menus runs it too).
